brand: CivicAid Beacon — Decentralized Disaster Relief & Medical Triage Hub

networks.name: civicaid_shelter_hub
networks.description: Coordinates accessible disaster shelters, backup power bays, and cross-origin cold-chain medical supply depots directly in the browser with zero PII leakage.
sample_queries: Find a wheelchair-accessible shelter for 4 evacuees needing refrigerated insulin and solar backup power.
Check cross-origin MedSupply depots for peritoneal dialysis kits and stage an emergency reservation.
Which shelter has pediatric asthma support and quiet sensory rooms within 3 km?

peer_policy.note: Contacts only verified humanitarian partner origins in allowed_peers after explicit visitor consent; sly_data is strictly blocked across origins.

agent_mcp.reason: Static GitHub Pages deployment; peer sites interact via the origin-checked action bridge and declarative network composition.
